scope: every Clifford level-3, distance >= 2 factory this collection holds, deduplicated on (n, k, d, GL(k,2) class of the gate); rows arrive from the exhaustive length-54 classification (d >= 3), from the borrowed-identity searches of Singh, Gidney and Jones (borrowed_identities/), from the doubled transversal-T codes of Jain and Albert (transversal_t_codes/), and from search campaigns merged in by merge_results.py
dedup_key: (n, k, d, gate up to GL(k,2)) -- circuits at different distances are always different classes; at one distance two gates are one class when an invertible change of the output basis (a CNOT frame) and diagonal Clifford corrections carry one to the other, the CNOT+S output equivalence; decided for every same-(n,k,d) pair by glcanon.gl_isomorphic. The stored circuit is one representative, shown in its S_k-canonical frame where that was proved

regimes.exhaustive classification n<=54 (Pareto: a Pareto point of the exhaustive classification of generalised triorthogonal protocols through length 54 (classification/length54/): no protocol with n <= 54, the same CNOT+S output class and the same exact distance has n and S both no larger and one of them smaller, where S counts every matrix row -- the N of this table
regimes.exhaustive classification n<=54: found within the exhaustive classification through length 54 but not one of its Pareto points: a Pareto point with the same output class (after removing spectator outputs) and the same exact distance strictly dominates it, which tests/test_master_catalog.py checks -- a verified witness, not an optimum
regimes.symmetry-SAT search: found by the symmetry-slot or ansatz-free SAT search (symmetry_sat_search/); a verified witness, not a maximum
regimes.AI search: found by an AI search campaign; a verified witness, not a maximum
regimes.AI search: punctured r=7 simplex parents: found by the 48 < n < 128 AI campaigns, from punctured r=7 simplex parents with free-row appending; a verified witness, not a maximum
regimes.AI search: multi-agent campaign 39<=n<=1: found by the 39 <= n <= 127 multi-actor AI campaign (three Opus 5 actors, two conferring Fable 5 reviewers, three rounds, 2026-09-01); a verified witness, not a maximum
regimes.AI search (gamma frontier): from Wills p: built from one of Wills's parent codes (weighted Reed-Muller, restricted-light or one-heavy) by searched punctures, paired-column contractions or logical-pair checks, in the pure-T distillation-exponent release (gamma = log(n/k)/log d, n < 1000); a verified witness, not a maximum -- only the release's own frontier points are the lowest gamma it knows
regimes.AI search (gamma frontier): contraction: a paired-column contraction of an existing triorthogonal code, in the pure-T distillation-exponent release (gamma = log(n/k)/log d, n < 1000); a verified witness, not a maximum -- only the release's own frontier points are the lowest gamma it knows
regimes.AI search (gamma frontier): logical rest: a restriction to fewer logical rows of a Pareto point of the length-54 classification, in the pure-T distillation-exponent release (gamma = log(n/k)/log d, n < 1000); a verified witness, not a maximum -- only the release's own frontier points are the lowest gamma it knows
regimes.AI search (gamma frontier): punctured Re: a punctured Reed-Muller code found by the gamma sub-1000 AI campaign (RM(3,10) punctured at 123 points), filed with the pure-T distillation-exponent frontier (gamma = log(n/k)/log d, n < 1000); a verified witness, not a maximum
regimes.AI search: Wills downset framework: verified witness from the 2026-09-14 wills_downset_theory campaign in magic-states-AI, which solved the arXiv:2608.24000 downset framework EXACTLY at every n <= 1000; the d=7 and d=8 rows are proved optima of that framework, not merely best-found, but the framework is one family and they are not maxima over all factories
regimes.AI search: pure-T width campaign n=255,: new [[n,k,d]] classes at n=255 and n=511 (the n=511 one the first at d=3 there) -- pure disjoint T^k, verified from columns. NOT rate records: both are strictly dominated by direct sums of the catalogued [[127,23,3]] (rho 5.5217) -- 2 copies give [[254,46,3]] and 4 give [[508,92,3]], each with FEWER inputs and MORE outputs than the row here. Beating the derived baseline needs k>=47 at n=255 and k>=93 at n=511.
regimes.AI search: generalised triorthogonal sea: found by the AI-assisted public search for generalised triorthogonal protocols at lengths 55-64; a verified witness, not a maximum
regimes.AI search: pure-T puncture caps: cap witnesses, NOT records. Each ATTAINS a proved maximum puncture count for its ambient size at d=6, making that bound exact rather than an upper bound: m=8 gives [[248,8,6]] and m=9 gives [[496,16,6]], both with n/t = 31 exactly, hence gamma = log(31)/log(6) = 1.9165 independent of m. Filed as evidence that these cells are closed, not as frontier points -- the d=6 pure-T bar is gamma 1.063146.
regimes.AI search: full-simplex pure-T frames: widest pure-T frames held at n=511. DOMINATED on rate by the derived direct-sum baseline [[508,92,3]] = 4 x [[127,23,3]], rho = 508/92 = 5.5217. These are WIDTH points, explicitly NOT rate records: beating the baseline at n=511 needs k >= 93.
regimes.AI search: graph gluing: found by an AI search that glues catalogued small factories along a graph of paired-column contractions; exact distance verified from columns; a verified witness, not a maximum
regimes.borrowed-identity search: two-group: found by the two-group borrowed-identity search of Singh, Gidney and Jones (arXiv:2606.28518; borrowed_identities/): an identity circuit symmetric within its output and check blocks, with its output-only gates removed; a verified witness, not a maximum
regimes.borrowed-identity search: symmetry-free: found by the symmetry-free, targeted-output borrowed-identity search of Singh, Gidney and Jones (arXiv:2606.28518; borrowed_identities/), which solves for the check couplings of a chosen output; a verified witness, not a maximum
regimes.Jain-Albert doubling: weak triply even f: a code of the weak triply even family of Jain and Albert (arXiv:2408.12752, Table II; transversal_t_codes/): quadratic-residue CSS codes doubled onto [[95,1,7]], rebuilt here from the paper's construction, where T on some qubits and T-dagger on the rest is a logical T; a verified witness, not a maximum
regimes.Jain-Albert doubling: triorthogonal fami: a code of the triorthogonal family of Jain and Albert (arXiv:2408.12752, Table I; transversal_t_codes/), self-dual CSS codes doubled onto [[95,1,7]], rebuilt here from the paper's construction; a verified witness, not a maximum
regimes.borrowed-identity search: SAT recovery: found by the SAT stage of the unified borrowed-identity search of Singh, Gidney and Jones (arXiv:2606.28518; borrowed_identities/), asked for a factory below the circuit size the other stages reach; a verified witness, not a maximum
regimes.Gong et al.: F8 codes concatenated with: a concatenated protocol of Gong, Pattison, Rall and Wills (arXiv:2608.09727; literature_imports/ccz72_d6/): an F8 code fed by copies of the 8T->CCZ protocol, rebuilt here from the paper's construction and written as one circuit; a verified witness, not a maximum

discovery.pre-existing: not an AI discovery of this project: a classification stage this repository ran, the symmetry-SAT search catalogue, the borrowed-identity searches, the codes of Jain and Albert rebuilt in transversal_t_codes/, the exhaustive length-54 classification alone, or a community contribution has this class
discovery.AI search: found only by AI search campaigns: no classification stage this repository ran, no symmetry-SAT search, no borrowed-identity search and no community contribution is recorded among its sources (the length-54 classification may have it too); whether it was new to the literature is what citations says

caveat: rows keep the regime they came from: a Pareto point of the length-54 classification is an optimality statement, a search witness is not. This table is their union, not a uniform claim.
verification: every field re-derived from the explicit columns by verify_catalog.py, which is re-run over the whole file rather than trusted from build time: gate (compared literally), check parities, distance (absence proved by exhaustive enumeration, presence witnessed by an explicit fault), output width modulo the check span, absence of spectator and pseudo-outputs, absence of check wires whose syndrome bit is an XOR of the other checks', exact minimal T-count and CNOT-frame-reduced degree where those are computable, and the Clifford correction that makes the accepted action exactly the gate (compared literally, then the corrected logical action evaluated directly, and simulated gate by gate on small circuits), with the rotation powers that avoid it or the proof that none do, and the leading error coefficient A_d -- the number of weight-d faults the checks accept and the outputs do not survive -- recounted as accepted less harmless faults and, where it finishes, by direct enumeration

sources.label: GPRW-72T-CCZ
sources.origin: A. Gong, C. A. Pattison, P. Rall, and A. Wills, "Magic State Distillation via Codes over Binary Extension Fields," arXiv:2608.09727 (2026)
sources.provenance: (8T -> CCZ) * (9CCZ -> CCZ) of Table 7: the F8 code of Construction 4.5, Eq. (49), binarised in the self-dual normal basis of Eq. (46), each of its nine input CCZ states made by its own 8T -> CCZ, written as one circuit with the nine inner checks as wires 9..17
sources.notes: A_6 = 37632. The paper states 10^{4.58} p^6 (Table 7). Its Eq. (189) with its Table 5 and the 8T -> CCZ error weights (12, 12, 4) p^2 gives exactly 37632, which is 10^4.576. factories.strongest_claim: cap witnesses, NOT records. Each ATTAINS a proved maximum puncture count for its ambient size at d=6, making that bound exact rather than an upper bound: m=8 gives [[248,8,6]] and m=9 gives [[496,16,6]], both with n/t = 31 exactly, hence gamma = log(31)/log(6) = 1.9165 independent of m. Filed as evidence that these cells are closed, not as frontier points -- the d=6 pure-T bar is gamma 1.063146.

sources.label: n248_T8_d6_CAP_WITNESS_not_a_record
sources.provenance: m = 8 maximal parent class 2 (|T| = 16 intersecting triples, dim 53). Campaign 2026-09-15_m8_m9_d6 proves t <= 8 on that parent at d = 6 (and t <= 16 over ALL 15 maximal m = 8 parents, closing the [[223,33,6]] cell); this ATTAINS the cap, so the bound is tight. Pure disjoint T^8, V_ex = 8, rho = n/V_ex = 31.000, gamma = log(248/8)/log 6 = 1.916545. NOT a record and not near one: the external d=6 bar is gamma 1.086033, and this is dominated many times over by direct sums of small catalogued factories (CLAUDE.md rule 6). Filed as a tightness witness for a closure, not as an improvement.
